$comment: Sentences for the banned-term rule of the answer check (web/js/core/answercheck.js), read by answercheck.test.mjs: hedged sentences a careful answer under the governance rule (prompt.js) would write, which must pass (expect: []), and plain claims, which must be marked (expect: the banned terms, as BANNED_TERMS names them). `tuning` holds the sentences the rules were changed for: the review's probe (未证实, 需…证实, To prove…, No study has shown…) and the forms the fix names. `heldout` was written before that change, from other wording, and was not used to tune the rules: answercheck.test.mjs holds it to the false-alarm rate and recall measured on it the first time it ran (the misses it still has are its own entries, not tuned away).
